workItem: Detach the LoginPage from the hCaptcha browser SDK while preserving the restored registration/login/recovery design.
workItemDE: LoginPage vom hCaptcha-Browser-SDK lösen und Registrierungsdesign erhalten
priorityReason: The user-visible login surface freezes when the CAPTCHA SDK is attached.
dependencies: CAPITAL-AI-OPS companion slice on the same coordinated branch removes backend captchaToken requirements.

evidence.designAuthority: SvenKulessa/FRONTEND login design remains unchanged apart from CAPTCHA runtime removal.

scopeBoundary: No hCaptcha script preload, render, execute or token request from LoginPage.
Preserve same-origin backend-first requests and legal-link behavior.
Do not restore direct supabase.auth to the browser.
acceptanceCriteria: LoginPage contains no hCaptcha import/runtime/token logic.
Registration/login/recovery remain visible and submit to existing backend routes.
Focused frontend tests pass on exact head.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, close, supersession or abandonment.
